spans.s: Other, different, another; see पर m. also.
Distant, removed, remote; अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः
Beyond, further, on the other side of; म्लेच्छदेशस्ततः परः

Subsequent, following, next to, future, after (usually with abl.);

Having as a following letter or sound, followed by (in comp.).

Exceeding, having a surplus or remainder, left over; as in परं

(At the end of comp.) Having anything as the highest

(Declined optionally
 like a pronoun in nom. voc. pl., and abl. and loc. sing. when it denotes

A prefix to verbs and nouns in the sense of ‘away, back, in an inverted order, aside, towards’
. According to G. M. the senses
 of परा are:−

N. of a river; तदुत्तिष्ठ पारासिन्धुसंभेदमवगाह्य नगरीमेव
